subject: using viewport and grid.layout multiple times for one pdf

messages.author: 9783d9fe56013431
messages.subject: using viewport and grid.layout multiple times for one pdf
parts:
Hi,
I am generating quite a few figures and I'm using

pdf(file="FILE.pdf")

pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(2, 1)))

then entering my plots (a,b)

followed by

print(a, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
print(b, vp = viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1))

Now, I'd like to do a second page of plots, up to many pages...all
into one pdf before ending the pdf.

I've played around with this a little but no matter what I do, my next
set of plots writes over the first one.
How do I keep plotting to the same PDF but entering new gridded plots
onto the next pages?

Many thanks.
